# Reckon House — Jeremy Prasatik

> Portfolio of Jeremy Prasatik. Design and engineering across brand, product, and place: apps and software, campaigns and brand systems, photography and art direction, custom interiors and material selection, AI tools and content infrastructure.

The work spans three areas: digital products, creative direction, and interior design. Most projects are designed and built by the same person, so the design decisions and the engineering decisions stay close.

This file lists the portfolio's case studies so agents and crawlers can find the full body of work. Each link is a self-contained case study with images, copy, and project detail.

## Digital — apps, ecommerce, AI tools

- [Sally Marketing OS](https://reckon.house/case-studies/sally): Product design and engineering. Five connected platforms in daily production use inside a Fortune 500 marketing team.
- [A.R.C. — AI Home Inventory](https://reckon.house/case-studies/arc): App and brand development. Computer-vision home inventory, concept to live product in ten weeks.
- [Ivy Park by Beyonce](https://reckon.house/case-studies/ivy-park): Digital design, brand launch.
- [Nordstrom Personalization System](https://reckon.house/case-studies/nordstrom-personalization): Design system, art direction.
- [Jeffrey NYC](https://reckon.house/case-studies/jeffrey-ecommerce): Ecommerce, web design.
- [Nordstrom Beauty](https://reckon.house/case-studies/nordstrom-beauty): Digital design, personalization.
- [Cosmo Prof](https://reckon.house/case-studies/cosmo-prof): Digital design, creative direction.
- [Dallas Sport Collective](https://reckon.house/case-studies/dsc): Website and custom app.
- [Nordstrom Framework](https://reckon.house/case-studies/nordstrom-framework): Content direction, design.
